mapper.select: SELECT id, program_id, program_job_id, referrer_id, candidate_id, job_position_id, relationship, referral_note, status, bonus_status, bonus_amount, bonus_paid, hired_time, create_time, update_time FROM ref_record WHERE referrer_id = #{referrerId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT r.id, r.program_id AS programId, r.program_job_id AS programJobId, r.referrer_id AS referrerId, r.candidate_id AS candidateId, r.job_position_id AS jobPositionId, r.relationship, r.referral_note AS referralNote, r.status, r.bonus_status AS bonusStatus, r.bonus_amount AS bonusAmount, r.bonus_paid AS bonusPaid, r.hired_time AS hiredTime, r.create_time AS createTime, r.update_time AS updateTime, c.name AS candidateName, NULL AS candidateUsername, jp.title AS jobTitle, d.dept_name AS departmentName, pjp.title AS programJobTitle FROM ref_record r LEFT JOIN smart_recruit_recruitment.rec_candidate c ON r.candidate_id = c.id LEFT JOIN smart_recruit_recruitment.rec_job_position jp ON r.job_position_id = jp.id LEFT JOIN smart_recruit_system.sys_department d ON jp.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN ref_program_job pj ON r.program_job_id = pj.id LEFT JOIN smart_recruit_recruitment.rec_job_position pjp ON pj.job_position_id = pjp.id WHERE r.referrer_id = #{referrerId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.id, r.program_id AS programId, r.program_job_id AS programJobId, r.referrer_id AS referrerId, r.candidate_id AS candidateId, r.job_position_id AS jobPositionId, r.relationship, r.referral_note AS referralNote, r.status, r.bonus_status AS bonusStatus, r.bonus_amount AS bonusAmount, r.bonus_paid AS bonusPaid, r.hired_time AS hiredTime, r.create_time AS createTime, r.update_time AS updateTime, c.name AS candidateName, NULL AS candidateUsername, jp.title AS jobTitle, d.dept_name AS departmentName, pjp.title AS programJobTitle FROM ref_record r LEFT JOIN smart_recruit_recruitment.rec_candidate c ON r.candidate_id = c.id LEFT JOIN smart_recruit_recruitment.rec_job_position jp ON r.job_position_id = jp.id LEFT JOIN smart_recruit_system.sys_department d ON jp.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN ref_program_job pj ON r.program_job_id = pj.id LEFT JOIN smart_recruit_recruitment.rec_job_position pjp ON pj.job_position_id = pjp.id WHERE r.candidate_id = #{candidateId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ref_record r LEFT JOIN smart_recruit_system.sys_user su ON r.candidate_id = su.id LEFT JOIN smart_recruit_recruitment.rec_candidate c ON r.candidate_id = c.id LEFT JOIN smart_recruit_recruitment.rec_job_position jp ON r.job_position_id = jp.id LEFT JOIN ref_program_job pj ON r.program_job_id = pj.id LEFT JOIN smart_recruit_recruitment.rec_job_position pjp ON pj.job_position_id = pjp.id

SELECT r.id, r.program_id AS programId, r.program_job_id AS programJobId, r.referrer_id AS referrerId, r.candidate_id AS candidateId, r.job_position_id AS jobPositionId, r.relationship, r.referral_note AS referralNote, r.status, r.bonus_status AS bonusStatus, r.bonus_amount AS bonusAmount, r.bonus_paid AS bonusPaid, r.hired_time AS hiredTime, r.create_time AS createTime, r.update_time AS updateTime, COALESCE(su.real_name, c.name) AS candidateName, su.username AS candidateUsername, jp.title AS jobTitle, d.dept_name AS departmentName, pjp.title AS programJobTitle FROM ref_record r LEFT JOIN smart_recruit_system.sys_user su ON r.candidate_id = su.id LEFT JOIN smart_recruit_recruitment.rec_candidate c ON r.candidate_id = c.id LEFT JOIN smart_recruit_recruitment.rec_job_position jp ON r.job_position_id = jp.id LEFT JOIN smart_recruit_system.sys_department d ON jp.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN ref_program_job pj ON r.program_job_id = pj.id LEFT JOIN smart_recruit_recruitment.rec_job_position pjp ON pj.job_position_id = pjp.id
ORDER BY r.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT r.referrer_id AS referrerId, u.real_name AS referrerName, d.dept_name AS departmentName, u.avatar AS avatar, COUNT(*) AS referralCount, COALESCE(SUM(r.bonus_amount), 0) AS totalBonus FROM ref_record r LEFT JOIN smart_recruit_system.sys_user u ON r.referrer_id = u.id LEFT JOIN smart_recruit_system.sys_department d ON u.department_id = d.id WHERE r.status = 3 GROUP BY r.referrer_id, u.real_name, d.dept_name, u.avatar ORDER BY referralCount DESC, totalBonus DESC LIMIT #{limit}
